mechanism: Keep the existing3-byte hint table and nearest4-byte hint, but index both A-family long-match trees by a6-byte prefix in the same65536-head capacity. Prefetch/tree-update indices are separated; short hints are not discarded because the tree head is now a different index.
difference_from_old_work: A matching and DP together are substantial remaining work. Unlike table resizing or depth sweeps, this changes candidate organization and may reduce both traversal and recorded alternatives. Losing older4/5-byte choices or increasing hint cost is an explicit risk, tested with actual encoded output first.
